Privacy Policy

Effective Date: November 2026

Home

Overview

No Brain Stickman Studio (accessible via this application) is an internal, private automation and content management tool operated exclusively by the channel owner.

Google User Data & YouTube API

This application uses the YouTube Data API v3 strictly to upload and schedule original animated videos to the channel owner's own YouTube channel (No Brain Stickman).

  • No Third-Party Data Collection: We do not collect, store, share, or sell any personal data, viewer information, or third-party user credentials.
  • Internal Channel Scope: The OAuth credentials used are scoped exclusively to manage video uploads and publishing on the creator's authenticated YouTube channel.
  • Google API Limited Use Compliance: The application's use of information received from Google APIs strictly adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Data Storage & Security

Any video files, scripts, and temporary metadata are stored securely within private Supabase database and storage instances owned and operated by the channel administrator.

Contact

If you have questions regarding this privacy policy, please contact the channel administrator at support@nobrainstickman.com.
